resources.string: Personal analysis overlay, powered by a local Stockfish engine. For training and post-game review - not for use during rated games.
Opens your chess app, freezes a screenshot, and lets you mark the board\'s four corners.
Switch to your chess app, make sure it shows the board, then tap \"Calibrate\" on the floating control panel.
Session started - look for the floating controls
No screen frame captured yet - try again in a moment
Chess Trainer is analyzing your screen
Chess Trainer move overlay is active
Could not load the screenshot - try calibrating again

Drag the four red handles onto the board\'s actual corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left) - the outer edge of the a8/h8/h1/a1 squares themselves, NOT any file/rank letters or numbers next to the board. Check the blue grid lines: every line should run exactly along a real square edge, all the way to the far corner - if a line is off by even part of a square near one edge, nudge the nearest handle until it snaps into place. Toggle the switch if black is shown at the bottom.
Now make sure THIS screenshot shows the standard starting position (all 32 pieces on their home squares), then tap below.
Capture piece templates from this screenshot
This looks backwards (white pieces came out darker than black ones) - the \"Black at bottom\" switch probably doesn\'t match this screenshot. Toggle it on step 1 and capture again.

Built for solo study and post-game analysis. Using any engine assistance during a rated game is cheating on virtually every chess platform and against over-the-board tournament rules - please don\'t use this overlay that way.
